patch_description: The current candidate regressed to 9 distinct parameters (ry_g0-3, rz_g0-3) which scored lower (0.64) than the earlier 5-distinct-parameter version (0.69). Parameter economy is heavily rewarded, so first we revert to the more efficient two-group RY/RZ parametrization (ry_a/ry_b, rz_a/rz_b) with a single shared zz_ring parameter. Second, per the recommendation, we interleave an XX ring immediately after the ZZ ring to mix orthogonal Ising interactions (X-type and Z-type entanglement), which has been shown to improve worst-group margins. To avoid increasing the parameter count (which is penalized without diminishing returns), we reuse the existing shared "zz_ring" parameter name for the XX gates rather than introducing a new parameter, keeping n_distinct_params at 5 while adding richer entangling structure that should improve robustness/margin without hurting parameter efficiency.
